description: Seven jacks turning the state of the network connection into voltages you can patch

outputs.text: A stepped voltage for the state of the connection: 0V offline, 3.3V connecting, 6.6V connected and 10V once in a room
10V while at least one other person is in the room, and 0V while you are alone
1V for each person connected, stopping at 10V
The worst connection quality across everybody connected, 0 to 10V, reaching 10V for the best rating
The average round-trip time across everybody connected, 0 to 10V with 10V at 100ms
The worst packet loss across everybody connected, 0 to 10V with 10V at one part in ten lost
The worst jitter across everybody connected, 0 to 10V with 10V at 50ms

notes: the connection, presence and count jacks change the instant the network does; quality, latency, loss and jitter are smoothed towards each new value so they do not click
the module reads the Resonance Hub in the same unbroken row and takes no peer slot, so it can go anywhere to the right of the Hub
